goal: Reorganize the existing site without deleting the archive so a new visitor understands Igor Vepretski, his story, topics, documented work, sources and contact paths within the first public experience.
changes: Homepage converged from system-first/living-archive presentation to a person-first public profile.
Hero now leads with Igor Vepretski, restrained positioning, short introduction and Story/Work/Contact actions.
Homepage now separates topics, documented work, timeline, selected media, selected content and the deep archive.
Documented work cards preserve a direct source route and explicitly distinguish registration or coverage from outcome evidence.
Primary navigation now exposes Home, My story, Work, Topics, Media and Contact; archive/system surfaces are secondary.
Bro Chat public branding was converged to Ask Igor / שאלו את איגור / Спросите Игоря with explicit AI/non-impersonation/source-grounding language.
Static crawl shells for Story, StartOn, Contact, Evidence, Research, Library and Media were made Igor-first and aligned to the v11 release marker.
Evidence crawl surface was expanded from three cards to nine selected source anchors, including external press, registry, authored columns, podcast, television and public coverage.
Homepage and deep-route SEO titles/descriptions were aligned so React hydration does not revert key Hebrew routes to system-first titles.
Sitemap duplicate leadership URLs were removed earlier in the same v11 convergence sequence; no content route was deleted.
Regression contract now covers 375px RTL, source boundaries, curated media, Ask Igor non-impersonation and route-specific public metadata.

evidence_policy.source_rule: A source proves only what the source supports; it does not automatically prove reach, impact, causation, partnership or outcomes.
evidence_policy.dynamic_evidence_surface: EvidencePage reads the live content graph and exposes source links and truth status per record.
evidence_policy.claim_boundary: Selected evidence anchors are navigation into evidence, not a claim that the public corpus is complete.
